M

mergeSettings(Map<String, ?>, Map<String, ?>) - Static method in class hibernate.base.persistence.tools.HibernateUtil
Merges predefined default settings with consumer-supplied overrides.
mergeSettings(Map<String, ?>, Map<String, ?>, Map<String, ?>) - Static method in class hibernate.base.persistence.tools.HibernateUtil
Merges predefined default settings, consumer-supplied overrides, and enforced safety invariants according to a strict three-tier precedence: defaults — baseline settings defined by the provider. consumerSettings — caller overrides that replace matching defaults. enforcedSettings — protected invariants that take final precedence and cannot be overwritten by consumer input.
MISSING_MAPPED_BY - Enum constant in enum class hibernate.base.persistence.tools.EntityLintRule
Bidirectional associations should specify mappedBy on the inverse side to avoid redundant join tables or duplicate foreign key updates.
MISSING_NO_ARG_CONSTRUCTOR - Enum constant in enum class hibernate.base.persistence.tools.EntityLintRule
JPA specification requires entity and embeddable classes to have a public or protected no-argument constructor.
